stemMarkdown: A point P is 8 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 4 cm. Find the length of the tangent from P to the circle (2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: The tangent, radius, and line from P to the centre form a right triangle (tangent ⊥ radius at the point of contact). Tangent length $= \sqrt{d^2 - r^2} = \sqrt{8^2 - 4^2} = \sqrt{48} = 6.93$ cm.
